title: Ko: No Immediate Recapture
intro: Some captures could be answered by an immediate recapture that repeats the same position. The ko rule prevents that repetition.

steps.explanation: Look at your new black stone. White could capture it back in the same place, so this shape is a ko.

steps.instruction: White has just captured your stone. Try to capture it straight back.
steps.hint: Try it. The game will refuse you.
steps.explanation: The move is refused because it would immediately repeat the previous position. Play elsewhere first.

outro: After both players have played elsewhere, recapturing may become legal. Your opponent can also fill the ko to end it.
